verdict.rationale: Typesense's own docs describe it as optimized for instant, typically sub-50ms search-as-you-type, and the homepage runs a live demo over 2.2M recipes that reports query time in milliseconds. A 32M-song live demo and Search UI Components are also documented, and a community user independently praised 'the instant search queries'. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on latency measurements (the sub-50ms figure is vendor-stated), and in-depth docs on per-keystroke prefix-query and UI wiring beyond a 'Search UI Components' heading.
